name: Jitsi Meet
description_en:
Jitsi Meet is an open-source video meeting application within the broader Jitsi project. Buyers should distinguish the public meet.jit.si service, their own deployment and the separately offered JaaS managed service.

The public service is no longer accurately described as unlimited-duration: an official October 9, 2026 notice sets a 95-minute meeting limit. That announcement concerns meet.jit.si, not a documented universal limit in the self-hosted software.
description_zh:
Jitsi Meet 是 Jitsi 项目中的开源视频会议应用。选型时应区分 meet.jit.si 公共服务、自行部署及另行提供的 JaaS 托管服务。

公共服务已不能准确描述为时长不限：2026 年 10 月 9 日官方公告将会议限制为 95 分钟。公告针对 meet.jit.si，不是已证实适用于自托管软件的通用限制。

core_features.explanation_en: Deploy the meeting application using the official self-hosting guide, with infrastructure operated by the owner.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可依官方自托管指南部署会议应用，基础设施由部署者运营。

core_features.explanation_en: The project links a public meeting service and a separate JaaS route; their terms are not identical.
core_features.explanation_zh: 项目提供公共会议服务及单独 JaaS 入口，两者条件不同。

en: A group can evaluate meet.jit.si for an occasional meeting, but should schedule within the documented 95-minute limit and establish what to do if a longer discussion is needed. The notice says further changes are coming. Check current service conditions before sending an invitation; older project-page text about all-day conversations does not override the dated announcement.
zh: 团队可评估 meet.jit.si 的临时会议用途，但应在已公布的 95 分钟内安排议程，并确定讨论超时时如何处理。公告还表示后续会继续变化，发送邀请前应核对当前服务条件；旧产品页的全天交谈文案不能覆盖有日期的新公告。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

sections.en:
A group can evaluate meet.jit.si for an occasional meeting, but should schedule within the documented 95-minute limit and establish what to do if a longer discussion is needed. The notice says further changes are coming. Check current service conditions before sending an invitation; older project-page text about all-day conversations does not override the dated announcement.

This research did not create a room, verify host authentication, test admission controls or measure browser/device compatibility. A recommendation to check these steps is not a tested onboarding recipe.
sections.zh:
团队可评估 meet.jit.si 的临时会议用途，但应在已公布的 95 分钟内安排议程，并确定讨论超时时如何处理。公告还表示后续会继续变化，发送邀请前应核对当前服务条件；旧产品页的全天交谈文案不能覆盖有日期的新公告。

本次未创建房间、核验主持认证、测试准入控制或测量浏览器/设备兼容性，建议检查这些环节不等于已实测入门流程。

sections.title_zh: 自托管会转移运维工作
sections.en:
The quickstart supports Debian 12 or newer and Ubuntu 24.04 or newer, requires privileged installation steps and OpenJDK 17, and asks the operator to configure a server domain and DNS. Its network instructions include TCP 443 and UDP 10000, with certificate issuance/renewal requirements. These are deployment prerequisites, not a promise that every NAT or existing web-server arrangement works unchanged.

The guide warns that self-signed certificates produce browser warnings and can prevent mobile applications connecting. Use trusted certificates and validate network routing, room access, updates and recovery in an authorized test environment. No server was installed and no TLS check was bypassed.
sections.zh:
快速安装指南支持 Debian 12 及以上、Ubuntu 24.04 及以上，包含需特权的安装步骤并要求 OpenJDK 17；运营者还需配置服务器域名及 DNS。网络说明包括 TCP 443、UDP 10000 和证书签发/续期要求。这些是部署前提，不保证所有 NAT 或现有网站服务器配置原样可用。

指南提醒自签证书会引发浏览器警告，并可能使移动应用无法连接。应使用可信证书，在获授权测试环境验证网络路由、房间访问、更新和恢复。本次没有安装服务器或绕过 TLS 检查。

sections.title_en: Apache licensing does not remove service costs
sections.title_zh: Apache 许可不会消除服务成本
sections.en:
The repository licence is Apache 2.0. This establishes an open-source software licence; it does not make compute, bandwidth, domain administration, maintenance or a managed JaaS subscription free. No current JaaS numeric price was read, so no normalized monthly amount is supplied. Obtain service-specific quotas and terms before comparing hosting options.

Self-hosting is a plausible evaluation route for teams with an operational owner; a group wanting no infrastructure maintenance should evaluate a hosted option separately. Capacity, recordings, retention, moderation, end-to-end encryption configurations and production recovery were not verified. Official sources sit on Jitsi project and repository domains while the public service uses jit.si.
sections.zh:
仓库许可为 Apache 2.0，这确立了开源软件许可，但不代表计算、带宽、域名管理、维护或 JaaS 托管订阅免费。没有实读当前 JaaS 数字报价，因此不提供标准化月费；比较托管方案前需取得各服务的配额及条款。

有运维负责人的团队可评估自托管；希望免基础设施维护的团队应另评托管方案。容量、录制、保留、主持控制、端到端加密配置和生产恢复均未验证。官方来源位于 Jitsi 项目及仓库域名，公共服务使用 jit.si。
